—"And she's supposed to be the daughter of 
a legendary Umamusume?" Disappointed 
murmurs echoed from the spectators who had 
come to Nakayama Racecourse to watch King 
Halo.

King Halo, however, refuses to give up. 
She vowed that she would definitely claim 
her next goal... the Japanese Derby.

King Halo returned to the academy at 
night, only to find Special Week by the 
front gate, talking about wanting to win 
the Japan Derby for her mother's sake.

"...Seeing her friend work hard with her 
mother's support, King Halo also begins 
running laps. Declaring that she, too, has 
a victory she cannot yield."
